title: feat: prevent leaking kubeconfig
body:
### Link to the application or project's homepage

https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/10485-kubernetes

### Reasons for making this change

Almost got tripped up myself leaking my kubernetes config.
When adding a kubernetes cluster to jetbrains ide by using "Paste kubeconfig content" the kubeconfig is stored under _.idea/kubernetes/configs/kubeconfig_somedate.yaml_

### Links to documentation supporting these rule changes
official jetbrains doc shows how to add a kubeconfig by pasting but sadly doesn't show the path in the doc
https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/kubernetes.html#add-cluster
